content.content: When invoked as `deccy remove <id>` naming an id that owns no change — the root — the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the id.
content.rationale: Removal abandons the named change, and an id that owns none gives it nothing to abandon; a node is the change its document is read from (S2-read nqktpzuu, S2-set ryzlzrkk), so no node owns none, and every other such id is D21's refusal (tsspuwzo) — the root is the one id that resolves to no file, so it names no change either. Refusing, and naming the id, keeps an unremovable invocation from passing as a removal.
